list.name: Start Here
list.author: Multiverse Video editors
list.description: Ten accessible videos, each with one concrete next action.

items.note: Framasoft's short, translated explainer of the Fediverse: many independent servers that talk to each other, like email.

Five concrete email-security rules from a digital-security hotline expert, framed around the phishing campaigns that target journalists and activists.
